summary.name: DressMeAI
summary.one_liner: DressMeAI is a browser-based AI virtual try-on service that shows how a clothing item would look on a photo of you, advertised at $1 per try-on.
use_cases: Preview how a clothing item looks before buying online
Create try-on images for fashion content
summary.what_it_does: You upload a full-body photo of yourself and a photo of a clothing item (JPEG, PNG or WEBP, up to 5 MB each). The AI analyzes body shape, proportions and pose, and generates a composite image of you wearing the garment in seconds. The page says it uses pose estimation, semantic segmentation to separate clothing from background, and a diffusion-based image generation model. The page also includes example before/after comparisons and outfit inspiration, but the marketing copy is heavy and offers few technical specifics.
notable: Runs in the browser; upload a person photo and a clothing image
Uses pose estimation, segmentation and a diffusion-based generator to composite the garment
Accepts JPEG, PNG or WEBP up to 5 MB, with automatic compression of large files
caveats: Advertised at $1 per try-on; the page does not explain paid tiers or limits further
Output quality depends on image quality, pose and clothing type, per the page's own disclaimer
Statistics such as 40% fewer returns and 1M+ try-ons are marketing claims without sources
